verses.en: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
verses.pt: Ora, quando Sambalate ouviu que edificávamos o muro, ardeu em ira,indignou-se muito e escarneceu dos judeus;
verses.en_web: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.
verses.en_bbe: Now, Sanballat, hearing that we were building the wall, was very angry, and in his wrath made sport of the Jews.

verses.en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
verses.pt: e falou na presença de seus irmãos e do exército de Samária, dizendo: Que fazem estes fracos judeus? Fortificar-se-ão? Oferecerão sacrifícios? Acabarão a obra num só dia? Vivificarão dos montões de pó as pedras que foram queimadas?
verses.en_web: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”
verses.en_bbe: And in the hearing of his countrymen and the army of Samaria he said, What are these feeble Jews doing? will they make themselves strong? will they make offerings? will they get the work done in a day? will they make the stones which have been burned come again out of the dust?

verses.en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
verses.pt: Ora, estava ao lado dele Tobias, o amonita, que disse: Ainda que edifiquem,vindo uma raposa derrubará o seu muro de pedra.
verses.en_web: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”
verses.en_bbe: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Such is their building that if a fox goes up it, their stone wall will be broken down.

verses.en: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
verses.pt: Ouve, ó nosso Deus, pois somos tão desprezados; faze recair o opróbrio deles sobre as suas cabaças, e faze com que eles sejam um despojo numa terra de cativeiro.
verses.en_web: “Hear, our God; for we are despised; and turn back their reproach on their own head, give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity;
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O our God, for we are looked down on: let their words of shame be turned back on themselves, and let them be given up to wasting in a land where they are prisoners:

verses.en: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
verses.pt: Não cubras a sua iniquidade, e não se risque de diante de ti o seu pecado, pois que te provocaram à ira na presença dos edificadores.
verses.en_web: don’t cover their iniquity, and don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”
verses.en_bbe: Let not their wrongdoing be covered or their sin washed away from before you: for they have made you angry before the builders.

verses.en: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
verses.pt: Assim edificamos o muro; e todo o muro se completou até a metade da sua altura; porque o coração do povo se inclinava a trabalhar.
verses.en_web: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height: for the people had a mind to work.
verses.en_bbe: So we went on building the wall; and all the wall was joined together half-way up: for the people were working hard.

verses.en: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
verses.pt: Mas, ouvindo Sambalate e Tobias, e os arábios, o amonitas e os asdoditas, que ia avante a reparação dos muros de Jerusalém e que já as brechas se começavam a fechar, iraram-se sobremodo;
verses.en_web: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;
verses.en_bbe: But when it came to the ears of Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabians and the Ammonites and the Ashdodites, that the building of the walls of Jerusalem was going forward and the broken places were being made good, they were full of wrath;

verses.en: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
verses.pt: e coligaram-se todos, para virem guerrear contra Jerusalém e fazer confusão
verses.en_web: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.
verses.en_bbe: And they made designs, all of them together, to come and make an attack on Jerusalem, causing trouble there.

verses.en: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.pt: Nós, porém, oramos ao nosso Deus, e pusemos guarda contra eles de dia e de noite.
verses.en_web: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.en_bbe: But we made our prayer to God, and had men on watch against them day and night because of them.

verses.en: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
verses.pt: Então disse Judá: Desfalecem as forças dos carregadores, e há muito escombro; não poderemos edificar o muro.
verses.en_web: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading, and there is much rubble; so that we are not able to build the wall.”
verses.en_bbe: And Judah said, The strength of the workmen is giving way, and there is much waste material; it is impossible for us to put up the wall.

verses.en: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
verses.pt: E os nossos inimigos disseram: Nada saberão nem verão, até que entremos no meio deles, e os matemos, e façamos cessar a obra.
verses.en_web: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”
verses.en_bbe: And those who were against us said, Without their knowledge and without their seeing us, we will come among them and put them to death, causing the work to come to a stop.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you.
verses.pt: Mas sucedeu que, vindo os judeus que habitavam entre eles, dez vezes nos disseram: De todos os lugares de onde moram subirão contra nós.
verses.en_web: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that when the Jews who were living near them came, they said to us ten times, From all directions they are coming against us.

verses.en: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.pt: Pelo que nos lugares baixos por detrás do muro e nos lugares abertos, dispus o povo segundo suas famílias com as suas espadas, com as suas lanças, e com os seus arcos.
verses.en_web: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.en_bbe: So in the lowest part of the space at the back of the walls, in the open places, I put the people by families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

verses.en: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verses.pt: Olhei, levantei-me, e disse aos nobres, aos magistrados e ao resto do povo: Não os temais! Lembrai-vos do Senhor, grande e temível, e pelejai por vossos irmãos, vossos filhos, vossas filhas, vossas mulheres e vossas casas.
verses.en_web: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”
verses.en_bbe: And after looking, I got up and said to the great ones and to the chiefs and to the rest of the people, Have no fear of them: keep in mind the Lord who is great and greatly to be feared, and take up arms for your brothers, your sons, and your daughters, your wives and your houses.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
verses.pt: Quando os nossos inimigos souberam que nós tínhamos sido avisados, e que Deus tinha dissipado o conselho deles, todos voltamos ao muro, cada um para a sua obra.
verses.en_web: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.
verses.en_bbe: And when it came to the ears of those who were against us, that we had knowledge of their designs and that God had made their purpose come to nothing, we all went back to the wall, everyone to his work

verses.en: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.pt: Desde aquele dia metade dos meus moços trabalhavam na obra, e a outra metade empunhava as lanças, os escudos, os arcos, e as couraças; e os chefes estavam por detrás de toda a casa de Judá.
verses.en_web: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: And from that time, half of my servants were doing their part of the work, and half kept the spears and body-covers and the bows and the metal war-dresses; and the chiefs were at the back of the men of Judah.

verses.en: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
verses.pt: Os que estavam edificando o muro, e os carregadores que levavam as cargas, cada um com uma das mãos fazia a obra e com a outra segurava a sua arma;
verses.en_web: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.
verses.en_bbe: Those who were building the wall and those who were moving material did their part, everyone working with one hand, with his spear in the other;

verses.en: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
verses.pt: e cada um dos edificadores trazia a sua espada à cinta, e assim edificavam. E o que tocava a trombeta estava no meu lado.
verses.en_web: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.
verses.en_bbe: Every builder was working with his sword at his side. And by my side was a man for sounding the horn.

verses.en: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
verses.pt: Disse eu aos nobres, aos magistrados e ao resto do povo: Grande e extensa é a obra, e nós estamos separados no muro, longe uns dos outros;
verses.en_web: I said to the nobles, and to the rulers and to the rest of the people, “The work is great and large, and we are separated on the wall, far from one another.
verses.en_bbe: And I said to the great ones and the chiefs and the rest of the people, The work is great and widely spaced and we are far away from one another on the wall:

verses.en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
verses.pt: em qualquer lugar em que ouvirdes o som da trombeta, ali vos ajuntareis conosco. O nosso Deus pelejará por nós.
verses.en_web: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”
verses.en_bbe: Wherever you may be when the horn is sounded, come here to us; our God will be fighting for us.

verses.en: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verses.pt: Assim trabalhávamos na obra; e metade deles empunhava as lanças desde a subida da alva até o sair das estrelas.
verses.en_web: So we did the work. Half of the people held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared.
verses.en_bbe: So we went on with the work: and half of them had spears in their hands from the dawn of the morning till the stars were seen.

verses.en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
verses.pt: Também nesse tempo eu disse ao povo: Cada um com o seu moço pernoite em Jerusalém, para que de noite nos sirvam de guardas, e de dia trabalhem.
verses.en_web: Likewise at the same time said I to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”
verses.en_bbe: And at the same time I said to the people, Let everyone with his servant come inside Jerusalem for the night, so that at night they may keep watch for us, and go on working by day.

verses.en: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.
verses.pt: Desta maneira nem eu, nem meus irmãos, nem meus moços, nem os homens da guarda que me acompanhavam largávamos as nossas vestes; cada um ia com a arma à sua direita.
verses.en_web: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me, none of us took off our clothes. Everyone took his weapon to the water.
verses.en_bbe: So not one of us, I or my brothers or my servants or the watchmen who were with me, took off his clothing, everyone went armed to the water.
